inputNotes.gravitationalParameters: JPL DE440; SI solar GM divided by 1e9 for km^3/s^2.
inputNotes.lunarDistances: NASA named mean perigee and mean apogee, not the full range of observed lunar distances.
inputNotes.synodicPeriod: Adopted Sky Lab mean 29.53059 d; NASA Moon Fact Sheet rounds this to 29.53 d.

data.normalization: Varying equatorial quadrupole term, relative to the lunar term at its reference mean distance; q is not local water level.
assumptions: Constant mean lunar and solar rates.
Earth-Moon distance fixed during each 48-hour experiment; Sun at 1 AU.
Inclination, eccentricity, ocean dynamics, coast shape, bathymetry, friction, lag, weather and uncertainty omitted.
Body sizes, orbit spacing and bulges exaggerated in the diagram.

display.solarGMConversion: Published SI solar GM divided by 1e9; display mantissa rounded to eight significant figures.

limitations: Idealized coplanar equatorial forcing using published reference inputs; this is not a local water-level prediction.
Distance and mean angular rates are fixed for each 48-hour experiment.
Ocean dynamics, local coast and basin geometry, inclination, eccentricity, friction, lag, weather and uncertainty are omitted.
